plan.title: Flaky test: injection 'logs fact hit counts in rag-runs' reads the fire-and-forget log before it is written (failed v0.87.1 release)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.docsJustification: Test-only change: one Vitest test in tests/lib/memory/injection.test.ts switches a single file read to a vi.waitFor poll. No behavior, CLI, route, config, or documented surface changes, so no doc file is touched; the inline comment in the test explains the poll.

narratives.Problem: The v0.87.1 release pack job failed on tests/lib/memory/injection.test.ts > 'logs fact hit counts and allocations in rag-runs' with 'expected [] to have a length of 1'. writeDecision in src/lib/memory/injection.ts (line 535) appends the rag-decision entry fire-and-forget (void appendFile), and the test reads the rag-runs log once immediately after injectPromptTimeMemory resolves, so on a loaded runner the entry has not landed yet.
narratives.Proposal: Test-only fix per the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-5432.md WI-1): replace the single readRagEntries() read at line 954 with a vi.waitFor poll (timeout 2000 ms, interval 20 ms) that filters rag-decision entries and asserts toHaveLength(1), treating read/parse errors as not-yet via .catch(() => []). Keep the three field assertions. Production code stays fire-and-forget. readRagEntries has exactly one caller; tests using injectWithLog capture the decision synchronously and query-expansion logging is awaited, so no other test needs the change.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Making the production rag-runs append in writeDecision awaited, or any change under src/
- Re-running or re-cutting the v0.87.1 release
- Tests that call injectPromptTimeMemory without logDecision and do not read the log (e.g. line 513 'escapes retrieved memory text')
- Changing the readRagEntries helper or tests/lib/memory/query-expansion.test.ts
- Adding real sleeps, fake timers, skipIf or .only to the test
- Adding a changelog.d entry (not user-facing)

autoDecisions.summary: Fix in the test only with vi.waitFor; keep the production append fire-and-forget.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body prescribes this test-only fix, and awaiting the log write would add latency to every prompt-time injection, which the design deliberately avoids.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope is the single test at line 954; no other test changes.
autoDecisions.rationale: grep shows readRagEntries has one caller; injectWithLog tests capture the decision via a synchronous logDecision callback, and query-expansion rag-runs writes are awaited end to end (logQueryExpansion awaited at query-expansion.ts lines 92, 131, 228).

The fix is one indivisible edit to one test; splitting would create items with no independent value.

items.title: Poll for the rag-decision entry with vi.waitFor in the 'logs fact hit counts and allocations in rag-runs' test

expected_outputs: vitest reports tests/lib/memory/injection.test.ts passing with 0 failures, including 'logs fact hit counts and allocations in rag-runs'
git diff origin/main --stat -- src/ prints nothing

narrative.Action: In tests/lib/memory/injection.test.ts, inside it('logs fact hit counts and allocations in rag-runs') (lines 936-960), replace `const entries = await readRagEntries(); const decisionEntries = entries.filter(...); expect(decisionEntries).toHaveLength(1);` with: a one-line comment `// writeDecision appends to rag-runs fire-and-forget, so poll until the entry lands.` followed by `const decisionEntries = await vi.waitFor(async () => { const found = (await readRagEntries().catch(() => [])).filter((entry: { type: string }) => entry.type === 'rag-decision'); expect(found).toHaveLength(1); return found; }, { timeout: 2000, interval: 20 });`. Keep the following three assertions (hitCounts.facts >= 1, budgets.facts === 1500, allocationBytes.facts > 0) unchanged. Do not modify readRagEntries, any other test, or any file under src/. Do not add setTimeout/sleep/vi.useFakeTimers. vi is already imported. See .pan/drafts/PAN-5432.md WI-1 for the exact before/after snippet.

items.title: Given the edited test file, when `npx vitest run tests/lib/memory/injection.test.ts` runs, then it exits 0 and the test 'logs fact hit counts and allocations in rag-runs' passes.

The test's only readRagEntries() call sits inside a vi.waitFor callback that is passed { timeout: 2000, interval: 20 }, catches read errors with .catch(() => []), and asserts toHaveLength(1) on the rag-decision entries it returns.
Given the polled rag-decision entry, when the test runs, then it still asserts and preserves the checks hitCounts.facts >= 1, budgets.facts === 1500 and allocationBytes.facts > 0.
`git diff origin/main -- src/` produces no output, and the diff adds no setTimeout, sleep or vi.useFakeTimers call to tests/lib/memory/injection.test.ts.
